test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.

The letter will be delivered by the postman tomorrow.

options.text: The postman delivered the letter tomorrow
The postman will have delivered the letter tomorrow
The postman will deliver the letter tomorrow
The postman will be delivering the letter tomorrow

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** active voice** changes the focus of the sentence from the action to the subject performing the action.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject "the postman" performs the action of delivering the letter.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence should be structured as** "The postman will deliver the letter tomorrow."**
 
• **Option 3** correctly expresses the sentence in **active voice.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
